title: Circadian Rhythm of Melatonin in Burns
brief_summary: Evaluate markers and postulated effectors of the endogenous circadian pacemaker in children admitted to the burn intensive care unit.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 5-18 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* anoxic brain injury
* preexisting neurological disorder
* pre-existing sleep disorder
* no informed consent or HIPAA release
